title: Listing Guard input schema (/api/v1)
description: The request bodies of the Listing Guard API in machine-readable form (ADR-022). Written from docs/input-schema.md, which stays the prose reference; a test in contract-tools holds every field table and every JSON example of that page to this file. The root is the request of POST /api/v1/checks; the other bodies are under $defs. Lenient like the API: unknown members are allowed and ignored (except in the image metadata, which is read strictly), strings are trimmed, and a number or boolean where a string is expected is read as its text. Limits are not here: they come from the versioned rulesets and GET /api/v1/rulesets/{marketplace}/limits.

CheckRequest.description: POST /api/v1/checks: the envelope. Only the object under listing depends on the marketplace. The whole body is at most 256 KB.

listing.description: The listing in the marketplace's own format: EtsyListing for ETSY, AmazonListing for AMAZON.

Marketplace.description: ETSY or AMAZON, case-insensitive. Another code is 400 unknown-marketplace.

Price.description: An object with amount (divided by divisor when divisor is given; currency or currency_code, upper-cased), or a plain number or numeric string with no currency. A price that cannot be read as a number counts as absent.

amount.description: A number or a numeric string.

divisor.description: Optional; zero or a non-number is ignored.

EtsyListing.description: Etsy Open API v3 style, snake_case.

taxonomy_path.description: Joined with ' > ' to form the category when category is absent.

images.description: Each entry is a URL string, or an object whose url_fullxfull (preferred) or url is the URL.

quantity.description: A JSON number; a string is not accepted. A fractional part is dropped.

EtsyPersonalization.description: Optional: the structured personalization questions of the listing. An empty questions array is the same as no personalization.

questions.description: An entry that is not an object is dropped.

type.description: TEXT, DROPDOWN or UPLOAD, in any case. Any other value is kept as written.

required.description: A JSON true or false; anything else counts as absent.

max_chars.description: The longest answer of a TEXT question. A JSON number; a string is not accepted.

options.description: The choices of a DROPDOWN, or the labels of the files of an UPLOAD. Duplicates are kept. An option given as an object is not read.

max_files.description: The number of files an UPLOAD accepts. A JSON number; a string is not accepted.

AmazonListing.description: A simple format for the US store. The SP-API attribute format is not accepted. Etsy fields such as tags are ignored.

search_terms.description: A string, or an array of strings joined with single spaces.

product_type.description: For example LUGGAGE. Matched to the ruleset ignoring case.

quantity.description: A JSON number; a string is not accepted. A fractional part is dropped.

images.description: URLs. Blank entries, and entries that are objects or arrays, are dropped.

item_highlights.description: The Amazon Item Highlights field. Optional.

AmazonCustomization.description: Optional: an Amazon Custom product. An empty surfaces array is the same as no customization.

surfaces.description: The print surfaces, in the order sent. An entry that is not an object is dropped.

max_chars.description: A JSON number; a string is not accepted. A fractional part is dropped.

options.description: In the order sent. Duplicates are kept; blank entries are dropped.

TrademarkCheckRequest.description: POST /api/v1/trademark-checks: the /checks envelope (normalized the same way) and an optional product_type next to it.

listing.description: As for POST /api/v1/checks: EtsyListing or AmazonListing.

product_type.description: Optional. A key of product_classes.types in the active trademark ruleset, written exactly, at most 64 characters. An undeclared key is 400 unknown-product-type. Not the Amazon product_type of the listing.

VariationCheckRequest.description: POST /api/v1/variation-checks: a parent and its children, at the top level of the body (not the /checks envelope).

variation_properties.description: Etsy only; ignored for Amazon. The names of the variation types.

children.description: In the order sent. An entry that is not an object, or has no non-blank field, is dropped.

VariationParent.description: Amazon only; ignored for Etsy. All fields optional.

product_type.description: For example SHIRT. Matched to the ruleset ignoring case.

variation_theme.description: For example Color-Size. Matched to the ruleset ignoring case.

parent_sku.description: Amazon only. Compared with the parent's sku exactly (after Unicode NFC).

attributes.description: Attribute name to value. An attribute whose value is an object or array is dropped.

PersonalizationScreeningRequest.description: POST /api/v1/personalization-screenings: the text a buyer typed for a custom product, at the top level of the body.

product_type.description: Optional free text, for example jersey. Hashed; no rule reads it yet.

print_profile.description: Optional. A profile declared in the ruleset; absent means the default. An undeclared code is 400 unknown-print-profile.

values.description: One entry per field of the order. An entry that is not an object, or has no text, is dropped.

label.description: Optional name of the field, for example name or number.

text.description: What the buyer typed. Not trimmed; never stored; never repeated in an answer.

ImageCheckMetadata.description: POST /api/v1/image-checks: the metadata part of the multipart request (the images are file parts named images, in the same order). Read strictly: an unknown member is 400 invalid-request.

profile.description: Optional. A profile of the marketplace's image ruleset; absent or null means the default. An undeclared name is 400 unknown-image-profile.

images.description: One entry per images part, in the same order.

source.description: Optional; absent or null means UNKNOWN. Only a declaration; nothing verifies it.
